lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance circular spots arranged in vertical columns of 3 to 5 units, extending posteriorly from the branchial region along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows, creating a defined checkerboard topology at the nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges exhibit a sharp vertical pixel gradient, with high luminance on the superior edge and shadow on the inferior edge, running parallel to the long axis.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparsely distributed small, low-intensity spots located within the leading and central regions of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple Echeneidae (remoras) are visible attached to the ventral surface and the trailing edge of the pectoral fin; possible minor irregular margin on the posterior edge of the dorsal fin.
